assumptionsNotMeasurements: 10 ms BLE scanning cycle and modeled queue timing
Sufficient independent LoRa receivers per channel at every collector
Pre-provisioned fleet, reliable off-air collector backhaul
No sea-reflection phase, real antenna pattern, GNSS interference, energy or regulatory model
No Vakaros protocol emulation or claim about its operational performance
Seeded motion along the initial heading or scripted ILCA route, per-boat speed 0.7–1.3 times input; fixed collector positions
Illustrative three-component deep-water wave field, roll RMS 12 degrees/m with +/-70 degree clip and collector roll halved; not ILCA hydrodynamics
Time-varying wave fading scale 3 dB/m and scalar polarization loss; 0.1 s propagation snapshots, in-flight packets rechecked at each snapshot
Per-link static shadowing held fixed within each evaluation; zero waves and zero speed retain stationary propagation
One-factor-at-a-time diagnosis followed by local search with 22% random restarts; no global optimum guarantee

Default windward mark 1,100 m from the start line. The 42.4 m leeward gate is centered at an editable signed offset, defaulting to +93 m. Routes pass between the marks before splitting and rounding outside the assigned mark. The map and both radios share the fleet distributions and scripted headings. Course playback extends vessel motion beyond the RF evaluation window.
Near-horizontal short-dipole coupling from each hull heading and heel, with a numerical floor for ideal nulls. Not an antenna-specific measured pattern.
Heading-relative shadow per racing boat: peak 4 dB aft by default, adjustable 0–20 dB and bow, stern, port or starboard.
Default boat mount heights sampled uniformly from 0.60 to 1.00 m above the water using the seed. The nominal 0.80 m and ±0.20 m spread are editable.
validation: node --test tests/*.test.mjs; checks software invariants, not prediction accuracy
